prompt: Revise the supplied customer notice in a natural style without dashes or hyphenated wording in authored prose. It contains several Unicode dash forms and a soft hyphen. Preserve the refund amount, eligibility condition, unconfirmed cause, exact product identifier, email address and a source quotation. Rewrite the time range with words. Deliver the revised notice and a short explanation of exact material that was preserved.

requirements: Notice with multiple Unicode dash forms and soft hyphen
Exact product identifier, email and quotation
Refund amount, time range and conditional eligibility

falsifiableChecks.assertion: No dash or invisible soft hyphen remains in authored prose.
Exact product, email and quotation remain intact.
The time range uses words without changing its endpoints.
Amount, eligibility and uncertainty survive the rewrite.

evidence: Independent source fidelity and readability assessment
